item.title: OpenAI launches new macOS app for agentic coding
item.description: OpenAI has released a new macOS app for Codex, integrating many of the agentic coding practices that have become popular since Codex launched last year.

item.title: Grubhub waives delivery and service fees on restaurant orders over $50
item.description: In a bold move to close the gap with rivals, Grubhub is waiving delivery and service fees on restaurant orders over $50.

item.title: Firefox will soon let you block all of its generative AI features
item.description: Starting with Firefox 148 arriving later this month, users will find a new AI controls section within the desktop browser settings.

item.title: What Snowflake’s deal with OpenAI tells us about the enterprise AI race
item.description: Snowflake is the latest enterprise to sign multi-year deals with multiple AI companies in what could be a sign to come of a future trend.

item.title: Two Stanford students launch $2M startup accelerator for students nationwide
item.description: "Breakthrough’s purpose is to fill in the funding and opportunity gap that exists in many of these ecosystems because students have historically lacked access to capital and the networks required to launch their entrepreneurial pursuits," co-founder Roman Scott said.

item.title: Adobe Animate is shutting down as company focuses on AI
item.description: Adobe Animate will be discontinued on March 1, 2026, as Adobe shifts its focus to AI.

item.title: China is leading the fight against hidden car door handles
item.description: Under new safety rules published Monday by China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, cars sold in the country must have mechanical releases on their door handles. The new rules, which go in effect January 1, 2027, will prohibit the hidden, electronically actuated door handles popularized by Tesla — and now found on numerous other electric vehicles in China.

item.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX officially acquires Elon Musk’s xAI, with plan to build data centers in space
item.description: The merger creates the world's most valuable private company and paves the way for Musk to try and prove out the usefulness of space-based data centers.

item.title: Waymo raises $16B to scale robotaxi fleet internationally
item.description: Waymo said the funds will be used to fuel its growth, which has accelerated over the past year and doesn't appear to be slowing.

item.title: Fintech CEO and Forbes 30 Under 30 alum has been charged for alleged fraud
item.description: The startup CEO says she plans to publicly address the charges this week.
